violations.text: Raw animal foods (such as breaded chicken cutlets) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as cooked meatballs) in the 2-door reach-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Food items were rearranged during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

Meatballs and sausage & peppers were observed held at temperatures ranging between 95 and 111 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food items had been loaded into hot hold unit less than 2 hours prior to the time of inspection and were reheated during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

Swiss cheese was observed held at 47 degrees Fahrenheit in deli display cooler #2. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food item was voluntarily disposed of during the time of inspection. Food items held within the cooler for less than 2 hours were moved during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

Logs of deli meats and cheese was observed not marked with the date of preparation/opening. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Establishment provided the dates of opening for food items during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Meatballs were placed hot in the refrigerator in covered containers greater than four inches deep. Food items were removed from the covered containers and placed into an open hotel pan to finish cooling. Proper cooling methods guidance provided during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

Various prepared food items packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Labeling guidance provided during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026
The receptacle in the women's toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2026
